pyramid_stagehand.text: Welcome to the Pyramid Stage. The first pyramid-shaped stage appeared in 1971 and the shape stuck.
The festival began on a dairy farm, and after it ends the fields go back to the cows. They are very forgiving.
When it rains the mud becomes a sport. Wellies are practically a uniform.

pyramid_soundtech.text: Please do not shout into the microphone. Shout in the empty field outside, it carries beautifully.
